settings.title: Blueberry Manhattan
settings.ingredients:
2 oz rye
1 oz Blueberry Daytrip
3 dashes aromatic bitters
settings.method: Add all ingredients to a mixing glass with ice and stir until chilled. Strain into a coupe glass. Garnish with a skewer of blueberries.

settings.title: Blueberry Kir Royale
settings.method: Build in a flute glass with Cava and garnish with blueberries.

settings.title: El Diablo
settings.ingredients:
1 oz tequila
1.5 oz Blueberry Daytrip
0.5 oz lime juice
Ginger beer
settings.method: Build in a Collins glass with ice; stir to combine.

settings.description: A blueberry wine-based amaro with a wild streak. Real blueberries meet bright citrus, warm vanilla and a nostalgic touch of cornlake sweetness. Deep berry flavor, fragrant botanicals and a lingering bitter finish keep every sip a little unexpected.
settings.quote_alt: “The Amaro I’ll be drinking all summer” — Sam Stone, Bon Appétit
settings.fact_copy: Wine-based amaro made with real fruit and botanicals
settings.callout_alt: Shake it with citrus, stir it with whiskey, or take it into espresso martini territory.
